It all starts with the user

Aurora is on a mission to solve user management once and for all. We are a globally distributed team dedicated to providing the best developer experience with obsessive attention to every detail.

Funded by industry-leading investors

Aurora is backed by investors with decades of experience building the world's best developer tools.

  • Andreessen Horowitz

    Backing bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology.

    Investor in Lyft, Slack, GitHub, and more.

  • CRV

    Investing with conviction since 1970.

    Investor in Vercel, Doordash, Airtable, and more.

  • Madrona

    Backing founding teams in seed, early, and acceleration stages in the Pacific Northwest and beyond.

    Investor in Amazon, Branch, and more.

Individual investors

Built with the trust of world-class founders, industry leaders, and dreamers working to make the web a better place.

Start now, no strings attached
